{{Quote|You're listening to the Grand Army of the Republic broadcast, the voice of the Outer Rim. This next one goes out to the Mud-Jumpers of the 224th, slugging it out on Mimban. Keep your heads down and your seals tight, boys.|The Bettie-Bot|audio=BettieBotVJ-Rookies.flac|<ref name="Rook" />}}
One particular [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of the [[LeisureMech Enterprises/Legends|LeisureMech Enterprises]] [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|BD-3000 luxury droid]] line, the '''Bettie-Bot VJ''', was responsible for a [[Music/Legends|music]] program on the [[Grand Army of the Republic broadcast/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic broadcast]] system of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] at [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]] were listening to her show just before they [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|fought for their lives]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], at which [[Time/Legends|time]] she dedicated a song to the [[Mud Jumpers/Legends|Mud-Jumpers]] of the [[224th]] before being shut off as their [[O'Niner/Legends|commanding officer]] entered the room.

==Biography==
A [[LeisureMech Enterprises/Legends|LeisureMech Enterprises]]&ndash;manufactured,<ref name="DB" /> [[Gender/Legends|feminine-programmed]] [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|BD-3000 luxury droid]], a model nicknamed "Bettie-Bot," hosted a program as a "VJ"<ref name="Episode Guide" /> on the [[Grand Army of the Republic broadcast/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic broadcast]] over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]<ref name="Rook" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWcanondates|105}}</ref> during which she played [[Music/Legends|music]] for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] fighting in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Rook" />

One group of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] stationed at the [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi moon]] tuned in to the Bettie-Bot's program during their downtime from scanning the region for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces heading for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. During the program, the Bettie-Bot sent a shout-out and dedicated her next [[Music/Legends|song]] to the [[224th]] [[Mud Jumpers/Legends|Mud-Jumpers]] unit [[Battle of Mimban/Legends|fighting]] on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]. However, the clones at Rishi Station had to terminate the [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] broadcasting Bettie-Bot's show to defend against a Confederate [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|assault]] on the Rishi [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="Rook" />

==Characteristics==
The Bettie-Bot was a feminine personality&ndash;programmed BD-3000 luxury [[Droid/Legends|droid]]<ref name="Episode Guide" /> who broadcasted during the Clone Wars. She had her own show, as a "VJ," on the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] broadcast HoloNet channel, where she played songs for people who tuned in, which included clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. She occasionally chose to dedicate a song to a person or group, such as she did for the 224th.<ref name="Rook" /> A BD-3000 was skilled linguistically, able to translate 1.5 million forms of communication with its language processors.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I||BD-3000 luxury droid}}</ref>

While the Bettie-Bot's music was important for morale, some within the Grand Army found her [[Jatz/Legends|jatz]] music to be outdated and turgid, and were lured to the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] instead for better musical selections, such as the [[leap-jump]] remixes played by the Separatist propagandist known only as "[[Ryloth Resa]]."<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bettie-Bot, working as a "VJ," appears as a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode entitled "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," voiced by [[Gwendoline Yeo]]. It premiered on [[October 24]], [[2008]].<ref name="Episode Guide" />

The Bettie-Bot's character origins go back to the conceptual stages of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] was originally to have a BD-3000 luxury droid aide working in his office. [[George Lucas]] described the female droid as the automated equivalent of [[Wikipedia:Bettie Page|Bettie Page]], a famous pin-up model; thus she was named the "Bettiebot." Although the scene was ultimately cut, the droid did appear, briefly, in other scenes of the film.<ref name="DB" />
